metadata.title: NebulaCoop
metadata.description: Online co-op for Super Mario Galaxy on PC. A fork of Nebula, the native port, with rooms of up to 16 players, room codes, shared worlds and co-op mods.

available.paragraph_1: The latest release for Windows, released

start.paragraph_1: Windows 10 (1803 or newer) or 11, 64-bit, a CPU with AVX2, a Direct3D 12 GPU and 8 GB RAM. Everyone in a room needs the same NebulaCoop version.
start.paragraph_2: You need Super Mario Galaxy for Wii, revision 0: North America (RMGE01), Europe (RMGP01) or Japan (RMGJ01), as an ISO, RVZ or extracted folder.
start.paragraph_3: Install with NebulaCoop Setup, open NebulaCoop from the Start menu, set your name on the PLAYER page, then Host a room or Join one by its code.

community.paragraph_1: Find players, get setup help and hear about releases on the NebulaCoop Discord. Report bugs on GitHub.

questions.paragraph_1: Yes. NebulaCoop, like Nebula, is free software under the GNU GPL v3. Everyone who plays needs their own copy of Super Mario Galaxy.
questions.question_2: How is it different from Nebula?
questions.paragraph_2: NebulaCoop is Nebula with online co-op added: rooms, shared worlds, chat, co-op mods and more. It follows Nebula closely and brings in its updates. Co-op problems belong on NebulaCoop's issue tracker, not Nebula's.
questions.paragraph_3: Not yet. For now, co-op comes as its own program, NebulaCoop, installed beside Nebula. After Nebula 2 is released, Mackery and keepvaibin plan to make co-op a mod you install into Nebula, so a separate program won't be needed. That's a plan, not a promise or a date.
questions.paragraph_4: Yes. NebulaCoop installs beside Nebula with its own folders and saves. The first install offers to import Nebula's game and saves.
questions.paragraph_5: Yes. Everyone in a room plays in NebulaCoop with their own supported disc. The game version, disc and mods are checked as each player joins, and joiners download any of the room's mods they don't have from the host.
questions.question_6: Do I need to forward ports?
questions.paragraph_6: No. Rooms go through NebulaNet, NebulaCoop's room-code service, by default. Direct connections to an address and port (UDP 7777) still work, with a forwarded port or a VPN such as Tailscale.
questions.question_7: Which copy of the game do I need?
questions.paragraph_7: Super Mario Galaxy for Wii, revision 0: North America (RMGE01), Europe (RMGP01) or Japan (RMGJ01), as an ISO, RVZ or extracted folder. Everyone in a room needs a supported disc.
questions.paragraph_8: 2 to 16 per room, 8 by default. The host picks the number. The world runs on the host's computer.
questions.question_9: Can I use my Nebula mods?
questions.paragraph_9: Yes. NebulaCoop runs Nebula's .luma mods. Co-op mods come as .lumacoop and run only in NebulaCoop. In a room, the host picks the mods.
questions.question_10: Which platforms does it run on?
questions.paragraph_10: Windows. Nebula's Linux, macOS and Android versions are not ready in NebulaCoop yet.
questions.paragraph_11: No. NebulaCoop is an independent project, not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Nintendo.

about.paragraph_1: NebulaCoop is a fork of Nebula, the native PC port of Super Mario Galaxy, that adds online multiplayer in the spirit of sm64coopdx. Several players share a galaxy, each with their own character, over the internet. You need your own copy of the game.
about.paragraph_3: Rooms of 2 to 16 players. Join by room code through NebulaNet, with no port forwarding, or connect directly.
about.paragraph_4: Mario, Luigi or a mod's character, with your own colours. Everyone in the room sees them.
about.paragraph_5: You play with whoever is on the same galaxy and star. The galaxy and star selects show who is where.
about.paragraph_6: Enemies, switches and boss fights are the room's. Coins and Star Bits are yours, but gone for everyone once taken.
about.paragraph_7: Float in a bubble instead of losing a life, and fly to another player to get back in. Plus player interaction, PvP and cheats.
about.paragraph_8: Chat, nametags, a player list, pop-ups, and /kick, /ban and /moderator for the host.
about.paragraph_9: LumaScript's coop calls and events, .lumacoop files, mod characters and colours. The room shares its mods.
about.paragraph_10: Keyboard, controllers and the Wii Remote, Direct3D 12 and Vulkan, upscalers, mods, achievements and saves.
about.built_on_2: and follows it closely. Everything that runs the game on a PC is Nebula's.
